agentUtterance.text:
I’ve sent an authorization to your receiver to sync your channels. This may take up to 2 hours for the missing channels to appear.

You can also reset your receiver. Hold the Power button on the front of your receiver until it turns off. Once it turns back on, check if the channels reappear.

Do you need more help on troubleshooting your TV?
I'll send a text to the device you're calling from for more information on TV troubleshooting. Is that alright?
